skirmish.name: Skirmish
skirmish.short: Close combat: fists, grappling, blades, holding your ground.

study.name: Study
study.short: Careful attention to detail: documents, research, reading a person, analyzing events.

sway.name: Sway
sway.short: Charm, lie and persuade to make someone do what you want.

consort.name: Consort
consort.short: Connections and charm: access to people, places, information and resources.

hunt.name: Hunt
hunt.short: Tracking, surveillance, ambushes and carefully aimed shooting.

command.name: Command
command.short: Intimidate and demand immediate obedience; lead a gang.

prowl.name: Prowl
prowl.short: Quiet, unseen movement: sneaking, hiding, running over rooftops.

survey.name: Survey
survey.short: Observe and anticipate: spot trouble, weaknesses and the right moment.

wreck.name: Wreck
wreck.short: Direct physical destruction: demolish, smash, sabotage.

attune.name: Attune
attune.short: Connect to the ghost field and arcane energies; commune with spirits.

tinker.name: Tinker
tinker.short: Work with devices: craft, repair, pick locks, rewire.

finesse.name: Finesse
finesse.short: Sleight of hand and deft maneuvering: pockets, driving, dueling.

blade-or-two.name: A Blade or Two
blade-or-two.short: A simple knife, a pair of sabers or a rapier with a stiletto; the kind depends on heritage.

pistol.name: A Pistol
pistol.short: A heavy single-shot breech-loader, deadly at twenty paces, slow to reload.

large-weapon.name: A Large Weapon
large-weapon.short: A two-handed weapon: axe, hammer, musket, blunderbuss, bow, crossbow.

unusual-weapon.name: An Unusual Weapon
unusual-weapon.short: A tool or curiosity turned into a weapon: whip, flail, shovel.

armor.name: Armor
armor.short: A thick leather coat, reinforced boots and gloves.

heavy-armor.name: +Heavy
heavy-armor.short: An armor add-on: chainmail, plates, helmet; its load adds to normal armor.

documents.name: Documents
documents.short: Pamphlets and registers of noble families, officials and the watch; paper, ink, maps.

demolition-tools.name: Demolition Tools
demolition-tools.short: Sledgehammer, iron wedges, heavy drill, crowbar.

tinkering-tools.name: Tinkering Tools
tinkering-tools.short: A kit for fine engineering work: loupe, tweezers, small hammer, pliers.

arcane-implements.name: Arcane Implements
arcane-implements.short: Quicksilver, black salt, spirit anchor, spirit bottle, vial of electroplasm.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.short: An oil lantern, electroplasmic lamp or other light source.

climbing-gear.name: Climbing Gear
climbing-gear.short: Ropes, grappling hook, chalk, harness, pitons and hammer.

lockpicks.name: Burglary Gear
lockpicks.short: Lockpicks, small crowbar, oil, wire, a pouch of sand.

disguise-kit.name: Disguise Kit
disguise-kit.short: Makeup kit, forgery forms, reversible cloak, fake watch badge.

spirit-bane-charm.name: Spirit Bane Charm
spirit-bane-charm.short: A small magical object that ghosts prefer to avoid.

haunted.name: Haunted
haunted.short: Visions, memories and hallucinations strike at the worst moment.

obsessed.name: Obsessed
obsessed.short: Fixated on an activity, a person or an ideology.

paranoid.name: Paranoid
paranoid.short: Sees danger everywhere and trusts no one.

unstable.name: Unstable
unstable.short: Fragile mind: rage, despair, impulsiveness or numbness.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.short: Doesn't care even about their own safety and interests.

vicious.name: Vicious
vicious.short: Looks for chances to cause harm, even with nothing to gain.

cold.name: Cold
cold.short: Emotions and ties to people mean nothing.

akoros.name: Akoros
akoros.short: The largest, most industrial region of the Empire, home to the capital and Doskvol; a blend of cultures like Europe.

iruvia.name: Iruvia
iruvia.short: A distant southern kingdom, mostly desert; cultures like ancient Persia, Egypt and India.

the-dagger-isles.name: The Dagger Isles
the-dagger-isles.short: Wanderers, corsairs and merchants raised on ships, good at getting along with spirits.

severos.name: Severos
severos.short: Wild lands by Imperial standards; nomadic tribes on scorched earth and ruins of ancient fortresses.

skovlan.name: Skovlan
skovlan.short: An island kingdom, the last to join the Empire; many of its people became refugees.

tycheros.name: Tycheros
tycheros.short: A semi-mythical place in the north said to be home to half-demons; requires a demonic trait.

noble.name: Noble
noble.short: A young aristocrat, courtier, descendant of an impoverished house.

law.name: Law
law.short: Lawyer, Bluecoat, inspector, Spirit Warden, guard.

labor.name: Labor
labor.short: Factory or railway worker, servant, docker, sailor.

underworld.name: Underworld
underworld.short: An urchin, gang member or hooligan raised on the streets.

gambling.name: Gambling
gambling.short: A love of cards, dice and wagers.

stupor.name: Stupor
stupor.short: Oblivion in drugs, drink or brawling until you pass out.

obligation.name: Obligation
obligation.short: Devotion to a family, cause, organization or charity.

pleasure.name: Pleasure
pleasure.short: Romance, food and drink, shows, art, drugs.

weird.name: Weird
weird.short: Experiments with essences, communing with spirits, rituals and taboos.

faith.name: Faith
faith.short: Worship of a secret power, a forgotten deity or ancestors.

unreliable.name: Unreliable
unreliable.short: When used, make a fortune roll based on the item's quality.

dangerous.name: Dangerous
dangerous.short: A side effect on the user counts as a consequence and can be resisted.

suspicious.name: Suspicious
suspicious.short: Conspicuous; using it on a score adds +1 heat.

consumable.name: Consumable
consumable.short: A limited number of uses; required for all alchemical substances.

complex.name: Complex
complex.short: Made in several stages, each a downtime action and a crafting roll.

big-bomb.name: Big Bomb
big-bomb.short: A large bomb with a long fuse.

grenade.name: Grenade
grenade.short: A small bomb with a short fuse and metal shrapnel.

smoke-bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smoke-bomb.short: A cloud of acrid smoke that hampers breathing and sight.

spark.name: Spark
spark.short: Electroplasm and seawater: a rush of energy and light crackling. Dangerous: level 1 harm "Drugged".

blood-needle.name: Blood Needle
blood-needle.short: Heat, euphoric mania, a burst of energy. Dangerous: level 1 harm "Drugged".

quicksilver.name: Quicksilver
quicksilver.short: A toxic metal that opens the mind to the ghost field: +1d to Attune. Dangerous: level 2 harm "Disassociated".

sleeping-smoke.name: Sleeping Smoke
sleeping-smoke.short: A mild version of black lotus, a pleasant intoxication. Dangerous: level 1 harm "Drugged".

trance-powder.name: Trance Powder
trance-powder.short: A blue powder that induces a pleasant trance. Dangerous: level 1 harm "Drugged".

black-lotus.name: Black Lotus
black-lotus.short: A paste giving deep oblivion with visions. Dangerous: level 1 harm "Drugged".

viper-potion.name: Viper Potion
viper-potion.short: The user's saliva and blood turn toxic for a few minutes. Spirit Wardens clock: 4 segments, +1 per use.

silence-potion.name: Silence Potion
silence-potion.short: A zone of total silence forms around the broken vial. Spirit Wardens clock: 4 segments, +1 per use.

shadow-essence.name: Shadow Essence
shadow-essence.short: Distilled void, a cloud of utter darkness. Spirit Wardens clock: 4 segments, +1 per use.

alkahest.name: Alkahest
alkahest.short: A liquid that ends the effect of any other alchemical concoction.

fire-oil.name: Fire Oil
fire-oil.short: Bursts into flame on contact with air.

binding-oil.name: Binding Oil
binding-oil.short: Permanently glues two surfaces together until dissolved by alkahest or electroplasm.

headache-fumes.name: Headache Fumes
headache-fumes.short: Fumes from superheated leviathan blood, causing terrible migraines. Dangerous: level 1 harm "Sickened".

drowners-powder.name: Drowner's Powder
drowners-powder.short: A dust that causes a sensation of suffocation and briefly incapacitates. Dangerous: level 1 harm "Sickened".

blinding-powder.name: Blinding Powder
blinding-powder.short: A powder that causes brief blindness. Dangerous: level 1 harm "Sickened".

paralytic-powder.name: Paralytic Powder
paralytic-powder.short: A powder that causes temporary paralysis. Dangerous: level 1 harm "Sickened".

devils-root.name: Devil's Root
devils-root.short: A plant extract that can kill whoever swallows it outright.

potion-of-vitality.name: Potion of Vitality
potion-of-vitality.short: Speeds recovery: mark 4 segments on the healing clock.

potion-of-insight.name: Potion of Insight
potion-of-insight.short: Lets you see the unseen and sense danger for several hours.

levitation-oil.name: Levitation Oil
levitation-oil.short: A coated object becomes weightless and floats for an hour.

ghost-oil.name: Ghost Oil
ghost-oil.short: Sends a material object into the ghost field; very dangerous to the living.

slow-death.name: Slow Death
slow-death.short: Slows the heartbeat for days, up to death.

life-essence.name: Life Essence
life-essence.short: Life force as vapor: postpones death, rarely resurrects; attracts the undead.

mind-essence.name: Mind Essence
mind-essence.short: A ghost's memories become the drinker's memories; serious side effects are possible.

dream-essence.name: Dream Essence
dream-essence.short: An extract of a vivid lucid dream, reproduced exactly for the drinker.

spirit-whip.name: Spirit Whip
spirit-whip.short: An electroplasm-charged chain with a spirit bottle that entangles and draws in a spirit.

black-salt-bomb.name: Black Salt Bomb
black-salt-bomb.short: Fills a small room, keeping ghosts from entering or leaving.

flare-bomb.name: Flare Bomb
flare-bomb.short: Pellets that explode in a dazzling flash.

grappling-gun.name: Grappling Gun
grappling-gun.short: A steam device that fires a rope and hook; the rank III version with a winch lifts a person.

spirit-lantern.name: Spirit Lantern
spirit-lantern.short: An electroplasmic lamp with a directed beam that repels ghosts.
